transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I'm here because for the past two years and five months, I've been experiencing extremely elevated moods and high energy, but I also get unpredictably irritable. It's been a constant roller coaster, and I finally decided I need to get some help for it.
During these periods of high energy, how much did they disrupt your daily life or work, and did you ever need to be hospitalized because of them?
To be honest, I'm not entirely sure about how much it has actually disrupted my daily life or work. I have never been hospitalized because of these episodes, though.
Have you ever experienced things like hearing voices, seeing things that others couldn't, or having strong beliefs that other people told you weren't true?
No, I have never experienced anything like that. I've never heard voices, seen things that weren't really there, or had beliefs that others disagreed with.
Besides these high-energy times, have you ever had periods lasting two weeks or more where you felt very down, depressed, or lost interest in almost all of your usual activities?

No, I haven't really experienced periods of feeling very down or losing interest in things for two weeks or more. My main experiences have just been the high energy and those unpredictable mood shifts I described.
During these high-energy times, did you find that you needed much less sleep than usual—like feeling fully rested after only a few hours—and did your thoughts feel like they were racing?
I haven't really noticed needing less sleep or having my thoughts race during those times. For the most part, my sleep and my thoughts feel pretty normal to me.
When you have these periods of high energy and irritability, how long do they typically last at a time?

I've actually been experiencing these periods of high energy and irritability on and off, sometimes almost continuously, for about two years and five months overall. They just keep coming back, so it feels like it has been going on for that entire time.
Did you have similar issues with high energy, restlessness, or difficulty staying still when you were a child, specifically before the age of 12?
I don't recall having any issues with high energy or restlessness when I was a child. These feelings really only started about two years and five months ago.
Alongside the irritability and high energy, do you find yourself worrying excessively about everyday things, and is this worry difficult to control?
No, I wouldn't say I experience excessive or uncontrollable worry about everyday things. My mind doesn't really get caught up in those kinds of anxious thoughts.
During these past two years, have you also had periods where you felt unusually low, sad, or lacking in energy, even if those times didn't last a full two weeks?

No, I haven't really experienced periods of feeling unusually low, sad, or lacking in energy over the past two years. My main experiences have actually been the exact opposite, with very high energy and elevated or irritable moods.
